content.title:
Scored quiz
Module 8
content.intro: This quiz covers all the lessons in this module. You must achieve 80% to pass. Good luck!

questions.prompt: What is one of the main factors driving increased electricity demand in buildings by 2050?

options.value: Increased use of air conditioning and cooling

correct.title: Correct
correct.body: Rising demand for residential cooling, particularly in emerging markets, is expected to triple by 2050, becoming a major contributor to increased electricity use in buildings.

wrong.title: Incorrect
wrong.body: Rising demand for residential cooling, particularly in emerging markets, is expected to triple by 2050, becoming a major contributor to increased electricity use in buildings.

questions.prompt: Which region is expected to see the most growth in middle-class households by 2034?

correct.title: Correct
correct.body: Asia-Pacific will host two-thirds of all middle-class households in emerging markets by 2029, with China and India seeing the largest increases.

wrong.title: Incorrect
wrong.body: Asia-Pacific will host two-thirds of all middle-class households in emerging markets by 2029, with China and India seeing the largest increases.

questions.prompt: Under the Net Zero Emissions (NZE) scenario, what percentage of energy demand is met by clean energy by 2050?

correct.title: Correct
correct.body: In the NZE scenario, 90% of global energy demand is expected to be met by clean energy by 2050.

wrong.title: Incorrect
wrong.body: In the NZE scenario, 90% of global energy demand is expected to be met by clean energy by 2050.

questions.prompt: Which of the following is a challenge associated with increased digitalization of energy systems?

correct.title: Correct
correct.body: Digitalization introduces new cybersecurity vulnerabilities as power grids and systems become more connected.

wrong.title: Incorrect
wrong.body: Digitalization introduces new cybersecurity vulnerabilities as power grids and systems become more connected.

questions.prompt: What is the projected increase in renewable capacity by 2030 according to the IEA?

correct.title: Correct
correct.body: IEA projections estimate that global renewable capacity will increase 2.7 times by 2030.

wrong.title: Incorrect
wrong.body: IEA projections estimate that global renewable capacity will increase 2.7 times by 2030.

questions.prompt: What share of the world's electricity was generated by nuclear power in 2023?

correct.title: Correct
correct.body: In 2023, nuclear power accounted for just over 9% of global electricity generation.

wrong.title: Incorrect
wrong.body: In 2023, nuclear power accounted for just over 9% of global electricity generation.

questions.prompt: Which of the following statements is true about hydrogen?

options.value: It emits greenhouse gases when used
Green hydrogen production is already widespread
Hydrogen can decarbonize sectors like industry and transport
Hydrogen is used mainly for residential energy

correct.title: Correct
correct.body: Hydrogen, particularly green hydrogen, has significant potential to decarbonize hard-to-abate sectors like heavy industry and long-haul transport.

wrong.title: Incorrect
wrong.body: Hydrogen, particularly green hydrogen, has significant potential to decarbonize hard-to-abate sectors like heavy industry and long-haul transport.

questions.prompt: What is one key barrier to renewable energy deployment in developing countries?

correct.title: Correct
correct.body: High costs of capital due to perceived risks and lack of de-risking mechanisms is a major barrier in developing economies.

wrong.title: Incorrect
wrong.body: High costs of capital due to perceived risks and lack of de-risking mechanisms is a major barrier in developing economies.

questions.prompt: Why are land and resource constraints a concern for renewable energy deployment?

options.value: Wind farms permanently occupy the land they use
Competition for land use can displace communities
Solar panels work better in urban areas

correct.title: Correct
correct.body: Large-scale renewable energy projects can conflict with land use for agriculture, conservation, and housing, especially in densely populated regions.

wrong.title: Incorrect
wrong.body: Large-scale renewable energy projects can conflict with land use for agriculture, conservation, and housing, especially in densely populated regions.

correct.body: According to IPCC-aligned pathways, nearly all new capacity additions by 2050 are expected to be from renewables.
